headline: A federal law renames the Avon, Minnesota post office at 317 Blattner Drive after W.O.C. Kort Miller Plantenberg.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 317 Blattner Drive in Avon, Minnesota. The building will be called the W.O.C. Kort Miller Plantenberg Post Office. It changes only the name and does not change how mail is handled or what services are offered.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the new name applies from that date.
